title: 6-Day Lite
description:
Introducing the 6-Day Lite, the latest addition to our adventure-ready lineup. The lightweight version to the 6-Day Pro. We designed the Lite for those who crave the versatility of the 6DP with the half the weight, twice the flex, and all the comfort available in pants. Whether you're on a dawn hike, a DH bike, or fishing off the dyke, the 6-Day Lite will be your new fav. Built for comfort, durability, and weather resistance, with streamlined storage and a casual fit perfect for both trail and town. Ready for whatever your day throws at you.

NOTE: If you are not sure, please choose a larger size. If you have any doubts about this product, we suggest you contact our customer support team. Due to the colour difference between screens on different electronic devices (computers, mobile phones or tablets), especially the CRT screen and the LCD screen, the colour of the item may be slightly different from what you see in the photos, please take the actual product as the standard.

Features:

- Our ultra light weight Zrilix™2 fabric was created to provide the perfect balance of durability, mobility, breathability, and wearability. One could say this proprietary material it is full of ability!  

- PFC Free DWR coated to protect from the elements

- Utilizes our elastic waist band for all day comfort and keeps the pants securely in place. Add a NF belt to keep them secured while loaded up.

- 2 Deep lay-flat hand pockets for safe and convenient storage, even while upside down.

- 4 unique thigh pockets provide ample storage will building or camping. Can conveniently stow pocket knifes, gloves, or hankies, etc.

- Robust belt and string loops provide tons of options to keep your pants or other accessories in place.

- Designed, produced and tested in Vancouver, Canada

Fit:

- Designed for a casual fit

- For intended looser style pick "true to size" 

- For tighter fit - size down 1 size

title: DP5™ All conditions Trail Trousers
description:
Perfection lies in the constant state of change - evolution if you will. 

Whether we like it or not (we love it) we are pants people. If you know someone who works for NF, chances are you've heard them talking about pants at the dinner table, at the pub, on the trailside, in the lift line, in their sleep.

We are talking about pants even when we are sick and tired of talking about pants. 

Anyway, lets talk about THESE pants. Why did we move away from the peoples favourite DP4? It's simple, because we are never happy with our work, and like a beaver with a leaky dam, our work is never done. What's working today may not serve the needs of tomorrow, then change begins.

NOTE: If you are not sure, please choose a larger size. If you have any doubts about this product, we suggest you contact our customer support team. Due to the colour difference between screens on different electronic devices (computers, mobile phones or tablets), especially the CRT screen and the LCD screen, the colour of the item may be slightly different from what you see in the photos, please take the actual product as the standard.

 

Introducing the All-New DP5! 

Features:

- Mid-weight zrilix™4 fabric provides great durability and weather protection 

- PFC Free DWR coated to protects YOU from the elements while not causing harm to the planet unlike other DWRs currently on the market.

- Breathable and stretchy to optimize comfort on the bike 

- Extra-deep lay-flat hand pockets for safe and convenient storage. Card pocket inside.

- Best in class phone pockets on both legs! with YKK semi-lock pullers

- Hidden waistband with belt channel  

- 3D Contour Fit™ 

- Designed, tested and handmade in East L.A., USA

 

Updated Fit for All! - 10 sizes

- Medium, Large, and X-Large sizes receive a "tall" option for our lanky friends. Increased inseam by 3 inches

- True to size fit is athletic tapered

- For a looser fit size up one size. 

 

Zrilix™ 4 Fabric

- GRS 4.0 Certified 100% recycled or post consumer materials

- 92% Nylon

- 8% Spandex

- PFC Free DWR finish

title: Quikstrike No. 77 - Beer and Loaming (the last one)
description:
QuikStrike No.77 - BEER AND LOAMING

Well this is it.. The final Quikstrike of six years of weird jerseys. I hope you love it!

If you don't get the reference, watch the cult classic movie 'Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas". Our Quikstrike tagline from day one has been "...Too weird to live, too rare to die" the final quote in the movie. ...And on the front, we replaced Jonny Depp smoking a cig with Yoann Barelli chewing a baguette. 

 

And as always, Quikstrike™ jerseys are made to order. Once all orders are in we will produce, then ship. Please allow up to two weeks to get your shipping notification.

Other Features: Anti-Bacterial, Wicking, UPF50

Recommended Care: Hand or machine wash cold with similar colours, hang to dry, iron low temperature

• QuikStrike jerseys are produced in limited numbers and their price reflects the the time and custom work put in by our team here at NF.

• QuikStrike products may take up to 7 business days or more to ship.

• All QuikStrike products are made to order.

title: Hemp Pocket Tee - Black
description:
Our Hemp pocket tee is your daily driver on and off the bike. 

Fits true to size. Fits like a basic t-shirt. 

Features:
• 53% Hemp 44% organic cotton 3% Spandex
• Grown since 8,000 BC, Hemp is the first plant used for textiles
• Requires no pesticides or herbicides. Naturally organic
• best fit for on and off the bike
• scoop cut front and back
• left chest pocket - good for a lens wipe, etc.
• Made in Canada

Benefits:
• Hemp is the most durable of all natural fibres
• Adapts well to weather
• Gets softer with age
• Excellent fit and mobility
• Supports small family business, meticulously rider-designed and ethically made all under one roof.

Fabric Composition
• 53% Hemp 44% organic cotton 3% Spandex

 

Why we made this?

We wanted a t-shirt that could work in all situations from chillin' to thrillin'. A less serious approach to gearing up for a ride, yet still having some performance features like good stretch and retention to sweat absorption and quick drying for when you need to wipe down your face after a sweaty climb.

Production Team:
Designer: Travis Bothner (Vancouver)
Developer: Alice Deng (Vancouver)
Cutting/Sewing/Finishing: NF1 Factory (Vancouver)

What does team rider Steve Vanderhoek think?
"Clean and stylish. From the trails to the bars... Look good, feel good"
